response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced senior engineer with genuine geospatial credentials (GISCollective, Green Map, FOSS4G talk) and proven low-latency systems work in D at Sociomantic handling millions of requests per second, which maps reasonably to the distributed-systems and performance demands of a routing pipeline. However, the core requirement — modern C++ (or Rust) in commercial or open-source settings — is only weakly met: his C/C++ exposure is a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015 and a university thesis, with the last decade spent primarily in TypeScript/Node.js and D. There is also no navigation, routing, or tiling experience. He could be a strong systems generalist worth a conversation given the 'willingness to expand across the stack' criterion, but he would need substantial ramp-up on the primary language and domain.
strengths: Real geospatial/GIS product experience, including founding an open-source geo-data platform
Low-latency, high-throughput backend work with async I/O, fibers, and caching at ad-tech scale
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, test tooling authorship, broad polyglot adaptability
concerns: Modern C++ experience is minimal and over a decade stale; no Rust at all
No navigation, routing, or map-tiling domain experience
Recent decade dominated by web/full-stack TypeScript rather than systems programming
